blind.description: A stack of neatly folded patterned fabric carpets/rugs with three tightly rolled rugs standing vertically against one side. The geometry is solid and continuous with stylized rounded textile folds and no detached, floating, or broken elements. The base sits flat on the floor without an added plinth. Materials are stylized woven fabrics in rich red, rust orange, cream, and dark green with tribal/geometric patterns.
blind.from_above: A rectangular folded red rug featuring an abstract light-colored central symbol with decorative borders, flanked on the top edge by the circular rolled ends of three upright carpets.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 feet tall (coming up to just below the waist/thigh of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide by 2.5 feet long.
